Class BookService

java.lang.Object
lms.application.BookService
public class BookService extends Object
Application-level service responsible for coordinating book-related use cases.

This service acts as the orchestrator between the presentation/UI layer and the domain + persistence layers. It handles:

  • Authorization (admin-only operations)
  • Delegating validation rules to the Book entity itself
  • Communicating with the BookRepository for persistence

Following clean architecture principles: Services coordinate, domain entities validate, repositories persist.

Author:
